    # Repeat the non-divider template segment between parallel divider lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Detect full-height divider columns and copy the template block into matching blocks.
    divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    if len(divs) >= 2:
        starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in divs]
        ends = divs + [w]
        blocks = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(starts, ends) if a < b]
        src = next(((a, b) for a, b in blocks if any(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h) for c in range(a, b))), None)
        if src:
            a, b = src
            for x, y in blocks:
                if (x, y) == src or y - x != b - a:
                    continue
                for r in range(h):
                    for k in range(b-a):
                        out[r][x+k] = grid[r][a+k]
        return out
    # Horizontal divider case: repeat the first pattern band into each later band.
    divrows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    if len(divrows) >= 2:
        starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in divrows]
        ends = divrows + [h]
        bands = [(a,b) for a,b in zip(starts,ends) if a < b]
        src = next(((a,b) for a,b in bands if any(grid[r][c] != 5 for r in range(a,b) for c in range(w))), None)
        if src:
            a,b=src
            for x,y in bands:
                if (x,y)==src or y-x != b-a: continue
                for r in range(y-x): out[x+r]=grid[a+r][:]
    return out
